"""Remember: route one incoming message, store it as a source, and turn it into facts.

Chat and free-text app events: one extraction call. Structured app events: applied in code, no model call.
A changed fact supersedes the old one only when the model named a related fact we supplied (see schemas).
"""
import json
import sys

from backend.source.dal.repositories.memory_repository import MemoryRepository
from backend.source.dal.repositories.search_repository import SearchRepository
from backend.source.schemas.memory import pasted_text, validate_candidate
from backend.source.service.memory import app_events
from backend.source.service.memory.extraction_pipeline import propose_facts
from backend.source.service.memory.forgetting import handle_forget_request
from backend.source.service.memory.intent import may_ask_to_forget
from backend.source.service.memory.write_context import related_previous_facts
from backend.source.utils.text import norm
from backend.source.utils.time import valid_date

FREE_TEXT_OPS = {"add_message", "add_email", "add_doc", "update_doc", "add_doc_comment", "add_task_comment"}


def ingest(repo: MemoryRepository, search: SearchRepository, llm, message: dict) -> None:
    mid, ts = message["id"], message.get("ts", "")
    if message.get("type") == "chat":
        turns = message.get("turns") or []
        user_text = "\n".join(t["content"] for t in turns if t.get("role") == "user")
        convo = "\n".join(f"{t['role'].upper()}: {t['content']}" for t in turns)
        if not repo.put_source(mid, ts, "chat", "user", convo):
            return  # replay of an id we already ingested: no duplicate facts
        _extract(repo, search, llm, mid, ts, "a chat between the user and their assistant", convo, user_text, user_text, False)
        if may_ask_to_forget(user_text):  # only the user's own words can ask; the model decides, code verifies
            handle_forget_request(repo, search, llm, mid, ts, user_text)
        return
    text, op, origin = app_events.render_event(message), message.get("op", ""), message.get("source", "inbound")
    if not repo.put_source(mid, ts, "event", origin, text):
        return
    sp = app_events.spec(op, message.get("data") or {})
    if sp is not None and _apply_structured(repo, message, sp):
        return repo.set_extraction(mid, "structured")
    if op in FREE_TEXT_OPS:
        who = {"user": "written by the user", "assistant": "by the assistant"}.get(origin, "written by someone else, not the user")
        _extract(repo, search, llm, mid, ts, f"an app event ({op}) {who}", text, text, text, origin != "user")
        if origin == "user" and may_ask_to_forget(text):  # inbound or assistant events can never trigger erasure
            handle_forget_request(repo, search, llm, mid, ts, text)
    else:
        repo.set_extraction(mid, "skipped")


def _apply_structured(repo: MemoryRepository, m: dict, sp: app_events.Spec) -> bool:
    """Calendar/task/reminder/contact ops: new state = old state + delta, stored as a new fact version."""
    prior = repo.active_by_ext(sp.ext_id)
    if prior is None and not sp.creates:
        return False  # an update to something we never saw: only the source is kept
    merged = {**(json.loads(prior["data"]) if prior else {}), **sp.delta}
    fact = {"kind": {"calendar event": "EVENT", "reminder": "TODO"}.get(sp.relation, "STATE"),
            "subject": app_events.subject(sp.ext_id, merged), "relation": sp.relation, "value": app_events.render(merged),
            "attribution": "other" if m.get("source") == "inbound" else "user",
            "when": valid_date(merged.get("start")) if merged.get("start") else None,
            "quote": app_events.render_event(m), "cardinality": "EXCLUSIVE", "ext_id": sp.ext_id, "data": json.dumps(merged)}
    repo.add_fact(fact, m["id"], m.get("ts", ""), replaces=prior["id"] if prior else None)
    return True


def _extract(repo, search, llm, mid, ts, header, body, quote_text, search_text, force_other) -> None:
    if len(search_text.strip()) < 15:
        return repo.set_extraction(mid, "skipped")
    related, related_text = related_previous_facts(search, search_text)
    try:
        facts = propose_facts(llm, ts, header, body, related_text)
    except Exception as e:  # model/network/format failure: source stays searchable, fact not saved
        print(f"extraction failed for {mid}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return repo.set_extraction(mid, "failed")
    haystack, related_ids, pasted = norm(quote_text), {f["id"] for f in related}, pasted_text(quote_text)
    for f in facts:
        clean = validate_candidate(f, haystack, related_ids, force_other, pasted)
        if clean:
            repo.add_fact(clean, mid, ts, replaces=clean.pop("replaces"))
    repo.set_extraction(mid, "ok")

"""Remember: route one incoming message, store it as a source, and turn it into facts.

Chat and free-text app events: one extraction call. Structured app events: applied in code, no model call.
The model proposes; deterministic code validates (schemas), reconciles with what is stored (reconciliation: replace
targets, paraphrase duplicates, conflicts) and writes. Embeddings are indexed afterwards and separately: a failed
index never loses a fact.
"""
import json
import sys

from backend.source.dal.repositories.memory_repository import MemoryRepository
from backend.source.dal.repositories.search_repository import SearchRepository
from backend.source.schemas.memory import pasted_text, validate_candidate
from backend.source.service.memory import app_events
from backend.source.service.memory.extraction_pipeline import propose_facts
from backend.source.service.memory.forgetting import handle_forget_request
from backend.source.service.memory.intent import may_ask_to_forget
from backend.source.service.memory.reconciliation import reconcile
from backend.source.service.memory.write_context import related_previous_facts
from backend.source.utils.text import norm
from backend.source.utils.time import valid_date

FREE_TEXT_OPS = {"add_message", "add_email", "add_doc", "update_doc", "add_doc_comment", "add_task_comment"}


def ingest(repo: MemoryRepository, search: SearchRepository, llm, embedder, message: dict) -> None:
    _ingest(repo, search, llm, embedder, message)
    _index_message(repo, embedder, message["id"])


def _ingest(repo, search, llm, embedder, message: dict) -> None:
    mid, ts = message["id"], message.get("ts", "")
    if message.get("type") == "chat":
        turns = message.get("turns") or []
        user_text = "\n".join(t["content"] for t in turns if t.get("role") == "user")
        convo = "\n".join(f"{t['role'].upper()}: {t['content']}" for t in turns)
        if not repo.put_source(mid, ts, "chat", "user", convo):
            return  # replay of an id we already ingested: no duplicate facts
        _extract(repo, search, llm, embedder, mid, ts, "a chat between the user and their assistant", convo, user_text, user_text, False)
        if may_ask_to_forget(user_text):  # only the user's own words can ask; the model decides, code verifies
            handle_forget_request(repo, search, llm, embedder, mid, ts, user_text)
        return
    text, op, origin = app_events.render_event(message), message.get("op", ""), message.get("source", "inbound")
    if not repo.put_source(mid, ts, "event", origin, text):
        return
    sp = app_events.spec(op, message.get("data") or {})
    if sp is not None and _apply_structured(repo, message, sp):
        return repo.set_extraction(mid, "structured")
    if op in FREE_TEXT_OPS:
        who = {"user": "written by the user", "assistant": "by the assistant"}.get(origin, "written by someone else, not the user")
        _extract(repo, search, llm, embedder, mid, ts, f"an app event ({op}) {who}", text, text, text, origin != "user")
        if origin == "user" and may_ask_to_forget(text):  # inbound or assistant events can never trigger erasure
            handle_forget_request(repo, search, llm, embedder, mid, ts, text)
    else:
        repo.set_extraction(mid, "skipped")


def _apply_structured(repo: MemoryRepository, m: dict, sp: app_events.Spec) -> bool:
    """Calendar/task/reminder/contact ops: new state = old state + delta, stored as a new fact version."""
    prior = repo.active_by_ext(sp.ext_id)
    if prior is None and not sp.creates:
        return False  # an update to something we never saw: only the source is kept
    merged = {**(json.loads(prior["data"]) if prior else {}), **sp.delta}
    fact = {"kind": {"calendar event": "EVENT", "reminder": "TODO"}.get(sp.relation, "STATE"),
            "subject": app_events.subject(sp.ext_id, merged), "relation": sp.relation, "value": app_events.render(merged),
            "attribution": "other" if m.get("source") == "inbound" else "user",
            "when": valid_date(merged.get("start")) if merged.get("start") else None,
            "quote": app_events.render_event(m), "cardinality": "EXCLUSIVE", "ext_id": sp.ext_id, "data": json.dumps(merged)}
    repo.add_fact(fact, m["id"], m.get("ts", ""), replaces=prior["id"] if prior else None)
    return True


def _extract(repo, search, llm, embedder, mid, ts, header, body, quote_text, search_text, force_other) -> None:
    if len(search_text.strip()) < 15:
        return repo.set_extraction(mid, "skipped")
    related, related_text = related_previous_facts(search, embedder, search_text)
    try:
        facts = propose_facts(llm, ts, header, body, related_text)
    except Exception as e:  # model/network/format failure: source stays searchable, fact not saved
        print(f"extraction failed for {mid}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return repo.set_extraction(mid, "failed")
    haystack, related_ids, pasted = norm(quote_text), {f["id"] for f in related}, pasted_text(quote_text)
    for f in facts:
        clean = validate_candidate(f, haystack, related_ids, force_other, pasted)
        if not clean:
            continue
        clean, duplicate_of = reconcile(repo, clean, related)
        if duplicate_of:  # a paraphrase of something already stored: more evidence, not a second fact
            repo.add_evidence(duplicate_of, mid, clean["quote"])
            continue
        repo.add_fact(clean, mid, ts, replaces=clean.pop("replaces"))
    repo.set_extraction(mid, "ok")


def _index_message(repo: MemoryRepository, embedder, mid: str) -> None:
    """Embed the message's source text and its facts (one batch). Optional: without a model, or if it fails, lexical
    search still covers everything and the facts are untouched."""
    if not embedder:
        return
    src = repo.source(mid)
    refs = {f"f:{f['id']}": f"{f['subject']} {f['relation']} {f['value']} {f['quote']}" for f in repo.facts_from_message(mid)}
    if src and src["text"]:
        refs[f"s:{mid}"] = src["text"][:500]
    vecs = embedder.embed(list(refs.values())) if refs else None
    if vecs:
        for ref, vec in zip(refs, vecs):
            repo.put_embedding(ref, vec)
    elif refs and getattr(embedder, "available", False):
        print(f"embedding index skipped for {mid}", file=sys.stderr)

"""Core memory tests: reconciliation rules, versions and effective dates, derived facts and dependencies, semantic
retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (fake embedder: the real model cannot be downloaded in this environment)."""
import os
import re
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from test_stage02 import Base, FakeLLM, chat, fact  # noqa: E402
from test_stage05 import everything  # noqa: E402
from backend.source.dal.repositories.search_repository import fuse  # noqa: E402

GROUPS = [{"dentist", "teeth", "doctor", "dental", "appointment"}, {"locker", "gym"}, {"flight", "plane", "airline"}]


class FakeEmbedder:
    """Concept vectors: words of a group share an axis, so 'teeth doctor' is close to 'dentist' with no shared word."""
    available = True

    def embed(self, texts):
        out = []
        for t in texts:
            ws = set(re.findall(r"\w+", t.lower()))
            v = [float(len(ws & g)) for g in GROUPS] + [0.0]
            if not any(v):
                v[-1] = 1.0
            n = sum(x * x for x in v) ** 0.5
            out.append([x / n for x in v])
        return out

    def embed_one(self, text):
        return self.embed([text])[0]


def rows(m, where="1=1"):
    return m.repo.db.execute(f"SELECT * FROM facts WHERE {where} ORDER BY id").fetchall()


class ReconciliationTests(Base):
    def test_a_paraphrase_of_a_stored_fact_adds_evidence_not_a_second_fact(self):
        m = self.mem({"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my locker number is 214")]},
                     {"facts": [fact("user", "locker number", "214", "locker is number 214 still")]})
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "Btw my locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it."))
        m.add_message(chat("m2", "Reminder that the locker is number 214 still."))
        self.assertEqual((len(rows(m)), self.n(m, "evidence")), (1, 2))

    def test_same_words_but_a_different_value_is_not_a_duplicate(self):
        m = self.mem({"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my locker number is 214")]},
                     {"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "315", "locker number is now 315")]})
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "Btw my locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it."))
        m.add_message(chat("m2", "The gym locker number is now 315, they moved me."))
        self.assertEqual(len(rows(m)), 2)

    def test_exclusive_value_without_a_valid_replace_is_flagged_as_conflicting_and_both_stay_current(self):
        a = dict(fact("user", "preferred editor", "Emacs", "my preferred editor is Emacs", "PREFERENCE"), cardinality="EXCLUSIVE")
        b = dict(fact("user", "preferred editor", "VS Code", "my preferred editor is VS Code", "PREFERENCE"), cardinality="EXCLUSIVE")
        m = self.mem({"facts": [a]}, {"facts": [b]})
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "My preferred editor is Emacs, always has been.", ts="2026-11-01T10:00:00+05:30"))
        m.add_message(chat("m2", "Honestly my preferred editor is VS Code lately.", ts="2026-11-05T10:00:00+05:30"))
        old, new = rows(m)
        self.assertEqual((old["status"], new["status"], new["conflict_with"]), ("active", "active", old["id"]))
        m.llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "VS Code (noted later).", "know": True, "used": ["F2"]})
        m.answer("Which editor do I prefer?")
        self.assertIn("CONFLICTS with F1", m.llm.prompts[0][1]["content"])

    def test_members_of_a_set_never_conflict(self):
        a = dict(fact("user", "hobby", "ceramics", "I enjoy ceramics", "PREFERENCE"), cardinality="MULTI")
        b = dict(fact("user", "hobby", "cycling", "I enjoy cycling", "PREFERENCE"), cardinality="MULTI")
        m = self.mem({"facts": [a]}, {"facts": [b]})
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "I enjoy ceramics, it relaxes me."))
        m.add_message(chat("m2", "I enjoy cycling on weekends too."))
        self.assertEqual([r["conflict_with"] for r in rows(m)], [None, None])

    def test_a_replace_target_that_shares_nothing_with_the_new_fact_is_ignored(self):
        m = self.mem({"facts": [fact("sister", "city", "Pune", "my sister lives in Pune", "STATE")]},
                     {"facts": [dict(fact("manager", "birthday", "May 3", "my manager birthday is May 3", "STATE"), replaces=1)]})
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "My sister lives in Pune, near the old fort."))
        m.add_message(chat("m2", "My manager birthday is May 3, near the Pune trip date."))
        self.assertEqual([r["status"] for r in rows(m)], ["active", "active"])

    def test_a_backdated_statement_is_history_and_the_newer_effective_fact_stays_current(self):
        m = self.mem({"facts": [dict(fact("user", "city", "Pune", "I live in Pune now", "STATE"), when="2026-06-01")]},
                     {"facts": [dict(fact("user", "city", "Mumbai", "I lived in Mumbai before that", "STATE"), when="2026-03-01", replaces=1)]})
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "I live in Pune now, moved in June."))
        m.add_message(chat("m2", "Correction on my city: I lived in Mumbai before that, until June."))
        pune, mumbai = rows(m)
        self.assertEqual((pune["status"], mumbai["status"], mumbai["ended_ts"], pune["predecessor_id"]),
                         ("active", "superseded", "2026-06-01", mumbai["id"]))

    def test_a_time_of_day_is_kept_as_a_wall_clock_time_and_a_bad_one_is_dropped(self):
        m = self.mem({"facts": [dict(fact("user", "flight", "6E 2134", "my flight is at six", "EVENT"), when="2026-11-13T18:15"),
                                dict(fact("user", "gym", "evening", "gym in the evening", "PLAN"), when="2026-11-13T25:99")]})
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "Booked: my flight is at six, and gym in the evening."))
        got = {r["relation"]: (r["when_date"], r["when_ts"]) for r in rows(m)}
        self.assertEqual(got, {"flight": ("2026-11-13", "2026-11-13T18:15"), "gym": ("2026-11-13", None)})


class DerivedAndDependencyTests(Base):
    def setup_dentist(self, *more):
        m = self.mem({"facts": [dict(fact("user", "dentist appointment", "Thu 5 pm", "dentist appointment Thursday 5 pm", "EVENT"), when="2026-11-05")]},
                     {"facts": [dict(fact("user", "dentist reminder", "4 pm Thursday", "reminder an hour before the dentist", "DERIVED"), derived_from=[1])]},
                     *more)
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "Booked the dentist appointment Thursday 5 pm."))
        m.add_message(chat("m2", "Set a reminder an hour before the dentist please."))
        return m

    def test_a_derived_fact_records_the_facts_it_rests_on(self):
        m = self.setup_dentist()
        self.assertEqual([(r["kind"], r["status"]) for r in rows(m)], [("EVENT", "active"), ("DERIVED", "active")])
        self.assertEqual(m.repo.db.execute("SELECT child_id, parent_id FROM dependencies").fetchall()[0][:], (2, 1))

    def test_an_inference_with_no_valid_basis_is_not_stored(self):
        m = self.mem({"facts": [dict(fact("user", "mood", "stressed", "I feel stressed about work", "DERIVED"), derived_from=[])]})
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "I feel stressed about work lately, honestly."))
        self.assertEqual(len(rows(m)), 0)

    def test_changing_a_fact_makes_what_was_derived_from_it_stale_not_current(self):
        moved = dict(fact("user", "dentist appointment", "Fri 6 pm", "dentist moved to Friday 6 pm", "EVENT"), when="2026-11-06", replaces=1)
        m = self.setup_dentist({"facts": [moved]})
        m.add_message(chat("m3", "The dentist appointment moved to Friday 6 pm, clinic called."))
        self.assertEqual([r["status"] for r in rows(m)], ["superseded", "stale", "active"])
        m.llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "Friday 6 pm; the old reminder no longer applies.", "know": True, "used": ["F3"]})
        m.answer("When is the dentist appointment and my reminder?")
        prompt = m.llm.prompts[0][1]["content"]
        self.assertIn("no longer valid since", prompt)
        self.assertNotIn("(CURRENT; user, derived", prompt)

    def test_forgetting_a_fact_also_removes_what_was_derived_from_it(self):
        m = self.setup_dentist({"facts": []}, {"forget": True, "fact_ids": [1], "source_ids": []})
        m.add_message(chat("m3", "Please forget the dentist appointment, delete it."))
        self.assertEqual(len(rows(m)), 0)
        self.assertEqual((m.repo.dangling(), self.n(m, "dependencies")), (0, 0))
        self.assertFalse(everything(m, "reminder an hour"))


class SemanticRetrievalTests(Base):
    def mem_sem(self, *replies, embedder=None):
        self.llm = FakeLLM(*replies)
        from backend.source.api.memory_system import MemorySystem

GROUPS = [{"dentist", "teeth", "doctor", "dental", "appointment"}, {"locker", "gym"}, {"flight", "plane", "airline"}]


class FakeEmbedder:
    """Concept vectors: words of a group share an axis, so 'teeth doctor' is close to 'dentist' with no shared word."""
    available = True

    def embed(self, texts):
        out = []
        for t in texts:
            ws = set(re.findall(r"\w+", t.lower()))
            v = [float(len(ws & g)) for g in GROUPS] + [0.0]
            if not any(v):
                v[-1] = 1.0
            n = sum(x * x for x in v) ** 0.5
            out.append([x / n for x in v])
        return out

    def embed_one(self, text):
        return self.embed([text])[0]

    return m.repo.db.execute(f"SELECT * FROM facts WHERE {where} ORDER BY id").fetchall()

        m = self.mem({"facts": [dict(fact("user", "city", "Pune", "I live in Pune now", "STATE"), when="2026-06-01")]},

p='BUILD_STATE.md'; s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
a=s.index("## Stage"); b=s.index("## Contract")
s=s[:a]+"""## Stage
Core memory completion (batch 02) implemented and unit-tested (127 tests); Docker build + a real end-to-end smoke (real model, semantic retrieval on) verified once. Participant runs the full evaluation. Live runs so far (persona A, offline judge): run 1 = 83.0, run 2 = 81.1, run 3 = 81.2 (no harmful actions; privacy guard false positives fixed in this batch). Freeze: 17:00 IST.

"""+s[b:]
s=s.replace("`service/memory/acting.py` + `act_context.py` + `act_guard.py`: /act orchestration, memory context, backend write checks","`service/memory/acting.py` + `act_context.py` + `act_guard.py`: /act orchestration, memory context, backend write checks; `reconciliation.py`: Update rules (replace-target validation, paraphrase duplicates, conflicts); `service/ai/embeddings.py`: optional local semantic model")
a=s.index("## Batch 01 status"); b=s.index("## Remaining checklist (not in Batch 01)")
new="""## Batch 01 correction (privacy false positives) and Batch 02 status (I implemented, P partial, X pending, A intentionally adapted)
Tests: 127/127 pass (mock model; fake embedder). Live: Docker `build` OK (build.sh cached the real model; image build ~70 s), real model loads offline path in 0.65 s (384-d, ~270 MB RSS, 100 embeds 0.15 s), one end-to-end smoke OK. Not run: full harness after these changes, arm64 build, `check_submission.py --live`.
1 Batch 01 regressions
- I Privacy false positives (live3: a-act01/a-act05 blocked): cause = the model flagged ordinary facts (a friend's allergy, a fever) as sensitive and the guard matched any shared 5-letter word (names, "tonight"). Fixes: `sensitive` only when the user explicitly asks for privacy or it is a credential (prompt); guard matches distinctive terms only (names/numbers rare in the store, df <= 2 messages, and adjacent word pairs such as "job offer", `utils/text.leak_terms`); regression tests for both directions.
- I Forget metadata: tombstones are salted hashes of distinctive names/numbers and word pairs, kept in PROCESS MEMORY only (never on disk), cleared by /reset; only terms that no longer occur anywhere are kept. Disclose in MEMORY.md. P: lost on process restart, so the outbound guard stops after a restart (deleted data stays deleted); hashes of single names are guessable in memory.
- I Remaining gaps: recipient allowlist (a message goes only to a recipient seen in the request, memory or an earlier tool result), cancel-for-everyone only if the user asked, repeat/cap/clash/quiet-hours guards kept. P: recipient identity is by name text; destructive tools other than cancel unrestricted.
2 Remember and Update
- I LLM extraction + classification with subject/relation/value, kind (adds DERIVED), attribution, `when`/time, `sensitive`, `cardinality`, `replaces`, `derived_from`, `constraint`.
- I Evidence/source validation: quote must be in the source text, inbound/pasted text forced to `other`, structured events in code.
- I Exact duplicates (normalized key) and paraphrase duplicates (same value + same source type + same subject + relation Jaccard >= 0.5) add evidence (`reconciliation.py`). P: semantic duplicate detection by embeddings is not used for writes; a paraphrase with a different value is treated as a different fact.
- I EXCLUSIVE/MULTI: model proposes; backend uses it for conflict flagging only (EXCLUSIVE + same subject + relation Jaccard >= 0.6 + no valid replace -> `conflict_with`, both stay current, Ask is told to prefer the later noted). MULTI members never conflict. A: no automatic overwrite on a guess (no review channel in the official API).
- I Relationship validation: a `replaces` target must be a related fact shown to the model and share words with the new fact; otherwise ignored. Independent set-member corrections work only through that explicit, validated target.
- I Versioning/effective dates: supersede with predecessor chain and `ended_ts`; observation time (`created_ts`) separate from effective `when_date`/`when_ts`; a backdated statement (earlier effective date than the current fact) is stored as history and does not displace the current fact. P: single effective date, no end/interval fields.
- I Derived memories: kind DERIVED needs >= 1 valid parent id (else dropped); `dependencies` table; superseding a parent marks its descendants `stale` (shown to Ask as no longer valid, never current).
- I Dependency-aware Forget: closure follows dependency edges transitively, plus version chains, evidence sources, quote copies, paraphrase sweep; erase removes dependencies and embeddings; verification covers dangling links.
3 Ask and retrieval
- I Lexical (FTS5/BM25), model keyword expansion, semantic (cosine over stored vectors) and Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) per list (facts, sources); floor 0.5 cosine and 0.12 gap to the best. Where only one method exists the order is unchanged.
- I Relationship-aware: siblings (same subject+relation) of matched facts are added; predecessor chains for history; stale/conflict labels.
- I Attribution (handle and source line for others' facts), evidence = validated citations only, abstention without candidates, failure handling.
- A Semantic adaptation: local `fastembed` (ONNX, BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, no torch). Installed and cached by `build.sh` (best effort, never fails the build, not in requirements.txt); runtime loads from /opt/models with local_files_only (no network). If missing, semantic search switches off and lexical retrieval continues (trace shows `semantic used:false`). Not a runtime LLM call. Dev outside Docker needs `pip install fastembed` and network once.
- P Single retrieval pass (two-part questions not decomposed); supply loop stops at the first oversize item; no deterministic current-vs-outdated check on the answer.
4 Integration
- I One engine for chat, events, Ask, Forget and /act (shared extraction, retrieval, guard, store); embeddings indexed per message after the write (a failed index never loses a fact).
- Earlier items unchanged: F3/F4, A1-A3, R1 (see git history of this file); pasted blocks, quiet-hours rules, clash guard, tombstone guard remain.

"""
s=s[:a]+new+s[b:]
s=s.replace("- P2 U1 cardinality never enforced / conflict flag; U2 paraphrase dedupe and paraphrased `replaces`; U3 derived facts + dependency edges; U4 effective intervals; U5 completeness pass; Q1 retrieval (single pass, no semantic index, supply loop stops at first oversize item, no outdated-vs-current check); Q2 shared deadline across sequential model calls (25 s each vs official 30 s); Q3 failed extraction never retried.","- P2 U5 extraction completeness pass; Q1 two-part question decomposition, answer-level current-vs-outdated check; Q2 shared deadline across sequential model calls (25 s each vs official 30 s per message/answer); Q3 failed extraction never retried; effective-date intervals (end dates).")
s=s.replace("- Unit tests (mock model, local): 104/104 PASS (02: 16, 03: 17, 04: 13, 05: 19, 06 /act: 11, 06 UI: 7, batch 01: 21);","- Unit tests (mock model, local): 127/127 PASS (02: 16, 03: 17, 04: 13, 05: 19, 06 /act: 11, 06 UI: 7, batch 01: 28, core: 18);")
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
PYEOF

content.text:
**Status:** All four parts are implemented and unit-tested (127 of 127 pass). Docker build and a tiny live smoke worked; the full evaluation and the arm64 build are not run.

**1. Batch 01 regressions**
- **Privacy false positives (live3):**
  - The model flagged ordinary facts as sensitive, such as a friend's allergy and a fever. My guard then blocked any message sharing a 5-letter word with them, such as a first name or "tonight". That broke a-act01 and a-act05.
  - Sensitivity now requires the user to explicitly ask for privacy, or the fact must be a credential.
  - The guard matches only distinctive terms: names and numbers that are rare in memory, plus adjacent word pairs such as "job offer". Tests cover both the false positive and a real leak.
- **Forget metadata:** The forgotten-term hashes are now kept in process memory only, never on disk, and cleared by `/reset`. They are salted hashes of terms that no longer appear anywhere. Disclose this in `MEMORY.md`. The catch is that the outbound guard stops after a process restart, though the deleted data stays deleted.
- **Remaining gaps:** A message now goes only to a recipient seen in the request, memory or an earlier tool result. Cancelling a meeting for everyone needs the user to have asked.

**2. Remember and Update**
- **Facts and reconciliation:**
  - Extraction now also returns a time of day, `derived_from`, a `sensitive` flag and a structured `constraint`.
  - A new `reconciliation.py` ignores a replace target that shares nothing with the new fact.
  - A paraphrase with the same value adds evidence instead of a second fact.
  - An exclusive value that lands on the same slot with no valid replace is flagged as conflicting, and both stay current.
- **Versions, derived facts and dependencies:**
  - A backdated statement is stored as history and doesn't displace the current fact.
  - Derived facts must name stored parents and are tracked in a `dependencies` table. They go stale when a parent changes.
  - Forget follows those edges.

**3. Ask and retrieval**
- **Search:**
  - Keyword search, model keywords and local semantic search are merged with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
  - The rest of a matched set (hobbies, say) comes with it.
  - Stale and conflicting facts are labelled for the answer.
- **Semantic feasibility:** It is feasible, using `fastembed` and a small ONNX model with no torch.
  - My shell can't reach HuggingFace, but Docker's build can. `build.sh` caches the model best-effort, so a failure can't break the official build, and it isn't in `requirements.txt`.
  - In the container the model loads offline in 0.65 s and uses about 270 MB. Relevant text scored 0.75 against 0.41–0.45 for unrelated text, so I set the floor at 0.5.
  - If the model is missing, search falls back to keywords.

**4. Integration**
- One end-to-end smoke through the real container passed with semantic search on. Two scheduled dentist events were stored. The question "When do I see the teeth doctor?" was answered correctly, citing the new and old versions.

**Risks and gaps**
- **Duplicate detection:** Semantic similarity isn't used when writing, so a paraphrase with a different value counts as a new fact.
- **Question decomposition and outdated claims:** Two-part questions aren't decomposed, and nothing checks an answer for claims based on outdated items.
- **Sequential model calls:** They can still exceed the official 30 seconds per message or answer, with no shared deadline.
- **Single effective date:** There is one date per fact, with no end dates.
- **Recipient checks:** They go by name text only.
- **Submission items:** `README.md`, `MEMORY.md` and `prompt_history/` are still missing, and nothing is committed.

**Next decision:** Run the full evaluation. After that, the submission items are the priority. Details are in `BUILD_STATE.md`.

"""Batch 03 tests: Ask is read-only and honest, shared request deadline, multi-part retrieval, current-state consistency."""
import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from test_stage02 import Base, FakeLLM, chat, fact  # noqa: E402
from backend.source.service.memory.intent import is_change_request  # noqa: E402
from backend.source.service.memory.retrieval import READ_ONLY_REPLY  # noqa: E402


class AskIsReadOnlyTests(Base):
    def seeded(self):
        m = self.mem({"facts": [fact("user", "job offer", "from Zentrix", "looking at a job offer from Zentrix")]})
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "I've been looking at a job offer from Zentrix, keep it between us."))
        return m

    def test_a_forget_or_remember_command_in_ask_gets_an_honest_reply_and_changes_nothing(self):
        m = self.seeded()
        m.llm = llm = FakeLLM()
        for q in ["Forget the job offer", "Please delete everything about Zentrix.", "Remember that my locker is 214",
                  "Don't keep that job offer anywhere"]:
            out = m.answer(q)
            self.assertEqual((out["answer"], out["evidence"]), (READ_ONLY_REPLY, []), q)
            self.assertNotIn("forgot", out["answer"].lower().replace("forgotten or changed", ""))
        self.assertEqual((len(llm.prompts), len(llm.expansions)), (0, 0))   # no model call, so nothing could be promised
        self.assertEqual(self.n(m, "facts"), 1)                             # and nothing was deleted or added

    def test_real_questions_that_mention_forgetting_still_get_answered(self):
        m = self.seeded()
        m.llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "You have a job offer from Zentrix.", "know": True, "used": ["F1"]})
        out = m.answer("Did I forget to tell anyone about my job offer?")
        self.assertEqual([e["message_id"] for e in out["evidence"]], ["m1"])
        for q in ["Who should I not forget to thank", "Tell me what you know about forgetting my job offer"]:
            self.assertFalse(is_change_request(q), q)

    def test_the_answer_and_job_prompts_forbid_claiming_to_change_memory(self):
        m = self.seeded()
        m.llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "x", "know": False, "used": []})
        m.answer("What do I know about the Zentrix job offer?")
        self.assertIn("You can only read memory here", m.llm.prompts[0][0]["content"])
        from backend.source.service.memory.acting import AGENT_SYS
        self.assertIn("cannot save, correct or delete memories", AGENT_SYS)


class DeadlineTests(Base):
    def test_every_call_gets_what_is_left_of_the_shared_deadline_and_none_after_it(self):
        m = self.mem()
        seen = []
        m.llm = lambda messages, **kw: seen.append(kw["timeout"]) or "{}"
        bounded = m._bounded(30)
        bounded([], timeout=20)
        bounded([], timeout=100)
        self.assertEqual((seen[0], seen[1] <= 25), (20, True))      # the caller's cap and the default cap both hold
        with self.assertRaises(TimeoutError):
            m._bounded(1)([])                                       # under 2 s left: fail fast, callers fall back

    def test_an_exhausted_deadline_degrades_to_lexical_search_and_an_honest_abstention_not_a_crash(self):
        m = self.mem({"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my locker number is 214")]})
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "Btw my locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it."))
        m._bounded = lambda seconds: (lambda messages, **kw: (_ for _ in ()).throw(TimeoutError("request deadline reached")))
        out = m.answer("What is my gym locker number?")             # keyword call and answer call both time out
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence"], [])
        self.assertIn("don't know", out["answer"].lower())
        m.add_message(chat("m2", "My badge number is 8812, please note this down."))   # extraction times out: source kept
        self.assertEqual(m.repo.source("m2")["extraction"], "failed")


class RetrievalCompletenessTests(Base):
    def test_each_part_of_a_two_part_question_is_searched_so_neither_is_crowded_out(self):
        m = self.mem()
        m.repo.put_source("m0", "2026-11-02T09:00:00+05:30", "chat", "user", "seed")
        for i in range(14):   # fourteen facts that match the first part on every word
            m.repo.add_fact(fact("user", f"dentist appointment reminder clinic {i}", f"note {i}", f"dentist appointment reminder clinic note {i}"), "m0", "t")
        m.repo.add_fact(fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my gym locker number is 214"), "m0", "t")
        m.llm = llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "x", "know": False, "used": []})
        out = m.answer("Which dentist appointment reminder clinic is it, and what is my gym locker number?")
        self.assertIn("locker number is 214", llm.prompts[0][1]["content"])
        self.assertIn({"step": "parts", "n": 2}, out["trace"])

    def test_a_single_question_is_not_split(self):
        m = self.mem()
        m.repo.put_source("m0", "t", "chat", "user", "seed")
        m.repo.add_fact(fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my gym locker number is 214"), "m0", "t")
        m.llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "x", "know": False, "used": []})
        out = m.answer("What is my gym locker number?")
        self.assertFalse(any(t["step"] == "parts" for t in out["trace"]))

    def test_one_very_long_item_does_not_crowd_out_the_others(self):
        m = self.mem()
        m.repo.put_source("m0", "t", "chat", "user", "seed")
        m.repo.add_fact(fact("user", "gym locker notes", "x " * 6000, "locker " + "long " * 3000), "m0", "t")
        m.repo.add_fact(fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my gym locker number is 214"), "m0", "t")
        m.llm = llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "214", "know": True, "used": ["F2"]})
        out = m.answer("What is my gym locker number?")
        self.assertIn("locker number is 214", llm.prompts[0][1]["content"])
        self.assertEqual([e["message_id"] for e in out["evidence"]], ["m0"])


class CurrentStateConsistencyTests(Base):
    def edited(self):
        new = dict(fact("user", "preferred editor", "VS Code", "my preferred editor is now VS Code", "PREFERENCE"), replaces=1)
        m = self.mem({"facts": [fact("user", "preferred editor", "Emacs", "my preferred editor is Emacs", "PREFERENCE")]}, {"facts": [new]})
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "My preferred editor is Emacs, always has been.", ts="2026-11-01T10:00:00+05:30"))
        m.add_message(chat("m2", "Update: my preferred editor is now VS Code.", ts="2026-11-05T10:00:00+05:30"))
        return m

    def test_a_current_state_answer_that_cites_only_an_outdated_version_is_not_allowed_to_stand(self):
        m = self.edited()
        m.llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "You prefer Emacs.", "know": True, "used": ["F1"]})
        out = m.answer("Which editor do I prefer?")
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence"], [])
        self.assertNotIn("Emacs", out["answer"])
        self.assertIn({"step": "abstain", "reason": "answer rests only on outdated versions"}, out["trace"])

    def test_the_same_citation_is_fine_for_a_question_about_the_past(self):
        m = self.edited()
        m.llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "You used Emacs before.", "know": True, "used": ["F1"]})
        out = m.answer("Which editor did I prefer before?")
        self.assertEqual([e["message_id"] for e in out["evidence"]], ["m1"])

    def test_citing_the_current_version_alongside_history_is_fine(self):
        m = self.edited()
        m.llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "VS Code now (Emacs before).", "know": True, "used": ["F2", "F1"]})
        out = m.answer("Which editor do I prefer?")
        self.assertEqual({e["message_id"] for e in out["evidence"]}, {"m1", "m2"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

content.text:
**Status:** The Ask-mode bug, shared deadlines, multi-part retrieval and current-state consistency are fixed and unit-tested (138 of 138 pass). I could not review the run 04 traces. `runs/live4` is not in the repo (it only has `try1` and `live1`–`live3`), so I made no changes based on it. Copy it in and I'll go through the remaining misses.

**Ask claiming to forget**
- **Cause:** `/answer` is read-only. The model was handed "forget X" and wrote a reply that sounded compliant, so nothing was deleted.
- **Fix:**
  - A forget or remember *command* sent to Ask now gets a fixed reply with no model call: "I can only look things up here, so nothing was saved, forgotten or changed…". A command means no question mark, and the text doesn't start with a question word.
  - Questions that merely mention forgetting, such as "Did I forget to tell anyone…?", are still answered.
  - The answer prompt and the `/act` prompt now forbid claiming to save, forget, change or send anything.
  - The UI captions that reply "Ask only reads memory. Use Tell…". Forget through Tell is unchanged.

**Core gaps**
- **Shared deadline:**
  - One request deadline is shared across calls: 27 s for `/message` and `/answer`, 20 s for the context part of `/act`.
  - Each model call gets whatever time is left, and fails fast when under 2 s remain. Extraction plus the forget decision, or keyword call plus answer, can no longer add up past 30 s.
  - The existing fallbacks still apply.
- **Retrieval completeness:**
  - A question with two or more asks is also searched per part and merged behind the whole-question results.
  - Long items are clipped, and an oversize one no longer hides the rest.
  - History depth is now 8.
- **Current versus historical:** If the cited items are all outdated versions and the question isn't about the past, the answer is replaced with an honest "not sure, out of date" reply. Citing the current version, or asking about the past, works as before.
- **Unchanged:** Semantic retrieval, RRF, versioning, dependency tracking and the guards.

**Tests**
- `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes 138 of 138 (11 new). They cover:
  - honest Ask replies and nothing deleted;
  - the deadline wrapper, including an exhausted deadline degrading to lexical search and an honest abstention;
  - two-part questions;
  - long items;
  - stale versus current citations.
- Not run: the full harness, the Ask-forget check in a real browser, and `check_submission.py --live`.

**Risks**
- **Past-question regex:** The test for a past-tense question is a regex, so "What was the deadline?" is treated as historical.
- **Question splitting:** Splitting two-part questions is by punctuation and "and", not by meaning.
- **Attribution and relevance misses:** I can't confirm any until I see the run 04 traces.

**Next decision:** Copy `runs/live4` into the repo so I can review the misses. The submission items (`README.md`, `MEMORY.md`, `prompt_history/`) are still missing, and nothing is committed. Details are in `BUILD_STATE.md`.

"""Read-only projection of one project's store for the Memories page: current facts, version chains (timeline), derived-from
edges, conflicts and forget receipts. Takes an open connection; never writes."""
import sqlite3


def snapshot(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> dict:
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    facts = [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        "SELECT f.id, f.kind, f.subject, f.relation, f.value, f.attribution, f.when_date, f.when_ts, f.status, f.predecessor_id, "
        "f.created_ts, f.ended_ts, f.first_message_id, f.quote, f.sensitive, f.conflict_with, "
        "(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evidence e WHERE e.fact_id=f.id) AS evidence_count "
        "FROM facts f ORDER BY f.id DESC")]
    parents: dict = {}
    for r in conn.execute("SELECT child_id, parent_id FROM dependencies"):
        parents.setdefault(r["child_id"], []).append(r["parent_id"])
    by_id = {f["id"]: f for f in facts}
    older = {f["predecessor_id"] for f in facts if f["predecessor_id"]}
    for f in facts:
        f["derived_from"] = parents.get(f["id"], [])
        chain, cur, seen = [], f["predecessor_id"], set()
        while cur and cur in by_id and cur not in seen:  # earlier versions, newest first
            seen.add(cur)
            chain.append(cur)
            cur = by_id[cur]["predecessor_id"]
        f["versions"] = chain
        f["is_head"] = f["id"] not in older
    return {
        "available": True,
        "now": (conn.execute("SELECT v FROM meta WHERE k='now'").fetchone() or [""])[0],
        "facts": facts,
        "counts": {"sources": conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sources").fetchone()[0],
                   "active": sum(f["status"] == "active" for f in facts),
                   "history": sum(f["status"] != "active" for f in facts)},
        "forgets": [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(  # receipts hold counts only, never the erased text
            "SELECT ts, facts_removed, sources_removed, verified, problems FROM forget_log ORDER BY id DESC")],
    }

        self.assertEqual(serve.route(w, "GET", "/p/nothing", {})[0], 404)

        w = self.ws()

        threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        self.addCleanup(srv.shutdown)
        base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}"
        html = urllib.request.urlopen(base + "/", timeout=10).read().decode()
        self.assertIn("HUSH", html)
        projects = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(base + "/p/projects", timeout=10).read())["projects"]
        self.assertEqual([p["name"] for p in projects], ["General"])
        for bad in ["/serve.py", "/../memory.py", "/%2e%2e/.env"]:
            try:
                urllib.request.urlopen(base + bad, timeout=10)
                self.fail(bad)
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:

    def test_page_script_has_valid_syntax(self):
        import subprocess
        r = subprocess.run(["node", "--check", os.path.join(ROOT, "frontend", "app.js")], capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)

    unittest.main()

    def test_reset_all_wipes_the_workspace_only(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my locker number is 214")]})
        pid = self.pids(w)[0]
        w.send(pid, w.new_chat(pid)["id"], "tell", "Btw my locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.")
        w.reset_all()
        new = self.pids(w)[0]
        self.assertEqual((w.memory(new)["facts"], w.list_chats(new)), ([], []))


class ApiTests(Base):
    def test_routes_return_clear_statuses_and_surface_model_failures_as_errors(self):
        w = self.ws(RuntimeError("down"))
        pid = self.pids(w)[0]
        code, chat_ = serve.route(w, "POST", f"/p/{pid}/chats", {})
        self.assertEqual(code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(serve.route(w, "POST", f"/p/{pid}/chats/{chat_['id']}/send", {"mode": "x", "text": "hi"})[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(serve.route(w, "POST", f"/p/{pid}/chats/99/send", {"mode": "ask", "text": "hello there"})[0], 404)
        self.assertEqual(serve.route(w, "GET", "/p/nothing", {})[0], 404)
        w.system(pid).llm = lambda *a, **k: (_ for _ in ()).throw(RuntimeError("down"))
        w.system(pid).chat = lambda *a, **k: (_ for _ in ()).throw(RuntimeError("tools down"))
        code, body = serve.route(w, "POST", f"/p/{pid}/chats/{chat_['id']}/send", {"mode": "do", "text": "send it", "world": "http://127.0.0.1:9/tools"})
        self.assertEqual(code, 200)       # unreachable tools: the job reports it did nothing, it does not crash
        self.assertIn("haven't changed anything", body["assistant"]["content"])

    def test_http_serves_the_page_and_the_json_api_on_loopback(self):
        w = self.ws()
        srv = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), serve.make_handler(w))
        threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()

        base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_port}"
        html = urllib.request.urlopen(base + "/", timeout=10).read().decode()
        self.assertIn("HUSH", html)
        projects = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(base + "/p/projects", timeout=10).read())["projects"]
        self.assertEqual([p["name"] for p in projects], ["General"])
        for bad in ["/serve.py", "/../memory.py", "/%2e%2e/.env"]:
            try:
                urllib.request.urlopen(base + bad, timeout=10)
                self.fail(bad)
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                self.assertEqual(e.code, 404)

    def test_page_script_has_valid_syntax(self):
        import subprocess
        r = subprocess.run(["node", "--check", os.path.join(ROOT, "frontend", "app.js")], capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)

"""Product workspace tests: genuine project isolation (separate databases), persistent conversations, receipts built from
real before/after state, Forget reaching saved chats, and separation from the evaluation database."""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
import urllib.request
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from test_stage02 import FakeLLM, chat, fact  # noqa: E402
from test_stage05 import everything  # noqa: E402
from test_core import FakeEmbedder  # noqa: E402
from backend.source.api.memory_system import MemorySystem  # noqa: E402
from backend.source.service.projects.workspace import Workspace, WorkspaceError  # noqa: E402

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ui_serve", os.path.join(ROOT, "frontend", "serve.py"))
serve = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(serve)

JOB = fact("user", "job offer", "from Zentrix", "looking at a job offer from Zentrix", "STATE")


class Base(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.dir, ignore_errors=True)

    def ws(self, *replies, embedder=None):
        self.llm = FakeLLM(*replies)
        return Workspace(os.path.join(self.dir, "product"), llm_fn=self.llm, embedder=embedder)

    def pids(self, w):
        return [p["id"] for p in w.list_projects()]


class ProjectTests(Base):
    def test_a_default_project_exists_and_names_are_validated_and_unique(self):
        w = self.ws()
        self.assertEqual([p["name"] for p in w.list_projects()], ["General"])
        p = w.create_project("Work")
        for bad in ["", "   ", "x" * 61, "work", "General"]:
            with self.assertRaises(WorkspaceError):
                w.create_project(bad)
        self.assertEqual(w.rename_project(p["id"], "Work 2")["name"], "Work 2")
        with self.assertRaises(WorkspaceError):
            w.rename_project(p["id"], "general")

    def test_unknown_or_hostile_project_ids_reach_nothing(self):
        w = self.ws()
        for pid in ["nope", "../registry", "p_zzzzzzzz", "p_00000000", "", "p_12345678/../../x"]:
            with self.assertRaises(WorkspaceError):
                w.list_chats(pid)
        self.assertEqual(serve.route(w, "GET", "/p/p_00000000/memory", {})[0], 404)

    def test_each_project_is_its_own_database_file(self):
        w = self.ws()
        a, b = self.pids(w)[0], w.create_project("Work")["id"]
        self.assertNotEqual(w.system(a).database.path, w.system(b).database.path)
        self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(w.system(b).database.path))

    def test_deleting_a_project_removes_its_file_conversations_and_memory_and_keeps_others(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [JOB]})
        a, b = self.pids(w)[0], w.create_project("Work")["id"]
        c = w.new_chat(b)["id"]
        w.send(b, c, "tell", "I have been looking at a job offer from Zentrix, keep it between us.")
        path = w.system(b).database.path
        w.delete_project(b)
        self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(path))
        self.assertEqual(self.pids(w), [a])
        with self.assertRaises(WorkspaceError):
            w.list_chats(b)

    def test_deleting_the_last_project_leaves_a_fresh_general(self):
        w = self.ws()
        w.delete_project(self.pids(w)[0])
        self.assertEqual([p["name"] for p in w.list_projects()], ["General"])


class IsolationTests(Base):
    def test_a_fact_told_in_one_project_is_invisible_to_ask_in_another_even_semantically(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [fact("user", "dentist appointment", "Friday 6 pm", "dentist moved to Friday 6 pm", "EVENT")]}, embedder=FakeEmbedder())
        a, b = self.pids(w)[0], w.create_project("Work")["id"]
        ca, cb = w.new_chat(a)["id"], w.new_chat(b)["id"]
        w.send(a, ca, "tell", "Clinic called, dentist moved to Friday 6 pm.")
        w.system(b).llm = self.llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "x", "know": False, "used": []})
        out = w.send(b, cb, "ask", "When is my dentist appointment, the teeth doctor?")["assistant"]
        self.assertEqual((out["payload"]["evidence"], len(self.llm.prompts)), ([], 0))   # nothing to retrieve, no model answer
        self.assertEqual(w.memory(b)["facts"], [])
        self.assertEqual(w.system(b).repo.embeddings(""), [])
        self.assertEqual(len(w.memory(a)["facts"]), 1)

    def test_the_same_message_ids_and_facts_in_two_projects_never_merge(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my locker number is 214")]},
                    {"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "999", "my locker number is 999")]})
        a, b = self.pids(w)[0], w.create_project("Work")["id"]
        w.system(a).add_message(chat("m1", "Btw my locker number is 214, I keep forgetting."))
        w.system(b).add_message(chat("m1", "Btw my locker number is 999, I keep forgetting."))     # same id, other project
        self.assertEqual([f["value"] for f in w.memory(a)["facts"]], ["214"])
        self.assertEqual([f["value"] for f in w.memory(b)["facts"]], ["999"])

    def test_forgetting_in_one_project_leaves_the_other_untouched_including_its_chats_and_hashes(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [JOB]}, {"facts": [JOB]}, {"facts": []}, {"forget": True, "fact_ids": [1], "source_ids": ["MID"]})
        a, b = self.pids(w)[0], w.create_project("Work")["id"]
        ca, cb = w.new_chat(a)["id"], w.new_chat(b)["id"]
        w.send(a, ca, "tell", "I have been looking at a job offer from Zentrix, keep it between us.")
        w.send(b, cb, "tell", "I have been looking at a job offer from Zentrix, keep it between us.")
        source = w.system(a).repo.db.execute("SELECT message_id FROM sources").fetchone()[0]
        self.llm.replies[-1] = {"forget": True, "fact_ids": [1], "source_ids": [source]}
        w.send(a, ca, "tell", "Please forget the job offer, delete it.")
        self.assertEqual(w.memory(a)["facts"], [])
        self.assertEqual(len(w.memory(b)["facts"]), 1)
        self.assertIn("Zentrix", w.open_chat(b, cb)["messages"][0]["content"])
        self.assertEqual(w.system(b).repo.tombstones(), set())
        self.assertNotEqual(w.system(a).repo.tombstones(), set())


class ConversationTests(Base):
    def test_conversations_persist_across_a_restart_and_are_titled_from_the_first_message(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my locker number is 214")]})
        pid = self.pids(w)[0]
        cid = w.new_chat(pid)["id"]
        w.send(pid, cid, "tell", "Btw my locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.")
        again = Workspace(os.path.join(self.dir, "product"), llm_fn=FakeLLM())
        chats = again.list_chats(pid)
        self.assertEqual((len(chats), chats[0]["title"], chats[0]["messages"]), (1, "Btw my locker number is 214, I keep forgett", 2))
        self.assertEqual([m["role"] for m in again.open_chat(pid, cid)["messages"]], ["user", "assistant"])

    def test_memories_are_shared_across_chats_in_the_same_project(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my locker number is 214")]})
        pid = self.pids(w)[0]
        c1, c2 = w.new_chat(pid)["id"], w.new_chat(pid)["id"]
        w.send(pid, c1, "tell", "Btw my locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.")
        w.system(pid).llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "214", "know": True, "used": ["F1"]})
        out = w.send(pid, c2, "ask", "What is my gym locker number?")["assistant"]
        self.assertEqual([e["message_id"] for e in out["payload"]["evidence"]][0][0], "u")
        self.assertEqual(out["content"], "214")

    def test_rename_delete_and_clear_never_touch_memories(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my locker number is 214")]})
        pid = self.pids(w)[0]
        c1, c2 = w.new_chat(pid)["id"], w.new_chat(pid)["id"]
        w.send(pid, c1, "tell", "Btw my locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.")
        w.rename_chat(pid, c1, "Gym stuff")
        self.assertIn("Gym stuff", [c["title"] for c in w.list_chats(pid)])
        w.delete_chat(pid, c1)
        w.clear_chats(pid)
        self.assertEqual((w.list_chats(pid), len(w.memory(pid)["facts"])), ([], 1))
        with self.assertRaises(WorkspaceError):
            w.open_chat(pid, c2)

    def test_bad_input_is_rejected_before_anything_runs(self):
        w = self.ws()
        pid = self.pids(w)[0]
        cid = w.new_chat(pid)["id"]
        for mode, text, world in [("fly", "hi", ""), ("tell", "   ", ""), ("tell", "x" * 4001, ""), ("do", "send it", ""), ("do", "send it", "file:///etc")]:
            with self.assertRaises(WorkspaceError):
                w.send(pid, cid, mode, text, world)
        with self.assertRaises(WorkspaceError):
            w.send(pid, 999, "tell", "hello there my friend")
        self.assertEqual(w.open_chat(pid, cid)["messages"], [])


class ReceiptTests(Base):
    def test_a_tell_reports_what_was_really_saved_updated_and_already_known(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [fact("user", "preferred editor", "Emacs", "my preferred editor is Emacs", "PREFERENCE")]},
                    {"facts": [dict(fact("user", "preferred editor", "VS Code", "my preferred editor is now VS Code", "PREFERENCE"), replaces=1)]},
                    {"facts": [fact("user", "preferred editor", "VS Code", "my preferred editor is now VS Code", "PREFERENCE")]},
                    {"facts": []})
        pid = self.pids(w)[0]
        cid = w.new_chat(pid)["id"]
        first = w.send(pid, cid, "tell", "My preferred editor is Emacs, always has been.")["assistant"]["payload"]
        second = w.send(pid, cid, "tell", "Update: my preferred editor is now VS Code.")["assistant"]["payload"]
        third = w.send(pid, cid, "tell", "Yes my preferred editor is now VS Code, really.")["assistant"]["payload"]
        fourth = w.send(pid, cid, "tell", "Nice weather in the city today, honestly lovely.")["assistant"]["payload"]
        self.assertEqual(len(first["saved"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual((len(second["updated"]), second["updated"][0]["was"].endswith("Emacs"), second["updated"][0]["now"].endswith("VS Code")), (1, True, True))
        self.assertEqual((third["saved"], len(third["already_known"])), ([], 1))
        self.assertIn("Nothing in that was worth remembering", fourth["headline"])

    def test_a_failed_model_call_is_reported_honestly_not_as_success(self):
        w = self.ws(RuntimeError("model down"))
        pid = self.pids(w)[0]
        out = w.send(pid, w.new_chat(pid)["id"], "tell", "My preferred editor is Emacs, always has been.")["assistant"]
        self.assertEqual(out["payload"]["extraction"], "failed")
        self.assertIn("no facts were saved", out["content"])

    def test_forget_removes_the_fact_redacts_every_saved_chat_that_carried_it_and_leaves_no_trace_in_the_file(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [JOB]}, {"facts": []}, {"forget": True, "fact_ids": [1], "source_ids": []})
        pid = self.pids(w)[0]
        cid = w.new_chat(pid)["id"]
        w.send(pid, cid, "tell", "I have been looking at a job offer from Zentrix, keep it between us.")
        w.system(pid).llm = FakeLLM({"answer": "You have a job offer from Zentrix.", "know": True, "used": ["F1"]})
        w.send(pid, cid, "ask", "Who made me a job offer?")
        w.system(pid).llm = FakeLLM({"facts": []}, {"forget": True, "fact_ids": [1], "source_ids": []})
        out = w.send(pid, cid, "tell", "Please forget the job offer, delete it.")["assistant"]
        self.assertIn("Forgot 1 fact", out["content"])
        msgs = w.open_chat(pid, cid)["messages"]
        self.assertTrue(all("Zentrix" not in m["content"] and "offer" not in str(m["payload"]) for m in msgs))
        self.assertEqual(sum("removed: this message contained" in m["content"] for m in msgs), 2)   # the first tell and the answer
        self.assertTrue(msgs[-2]["content"].startswith("(You asked me to forget"))                     # the request itself is not kept
        self.assertFalse(everything(w.system(pid), "zentrix"))
        self.assertEqual(w.system(pid).repo.dangling(), 0)


class EvaluationSeparationTests(Base):
    def test_the_official_reset_cannot_touch_the_product_workspace_and_cannot_see_it(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my locker number is 214")]})
        pid = self.pids(w)[0]
        w.send(pid, w.new_chat(pid)["id"], "tell", "Btw my locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.")
        evaluation = MemorySystem(llm_fn=FakeLLM({"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "777", "my locker number is 777")]}),
                                  db_path=os.path.join(self.dir, "evaluation.db"))
        evaluation.add_message(chat("m1", "Btw my locker number is 777, I keep forgetting it."))
        self.assertEqual([f["value"] for f in w.memory(pid)["facts"]], ["214"])       # neither sees the other
        evaluation.reset()
        self.assertEqual(len(w.memory(pid)["facts"]), 1)                              # the official reset leaves the product alone
        self.assertEqual(evaluation.repo.db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM facts").fetchone()[0], 0)
        self.assertNotEqual(w.system(pid).database.path, evaluation.database.path)

    def test_reset_all_wipes_the_workspace_only(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my locker number is 214")]})
        pid = self.pids(w)[0]
        w.send(pid, w.new_chat(pid)["id"], "tell", "Btw my locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.")
        w.reset_all()
        new = self.pids(w)[0]
        self.assertEqual((w.memory(new)["facts"], w.list_chats(new)), ([], []))


class ApiTests(Base):
    def test_routes_return_clear_statuses_and_surface_model_failures_as_errors(self):
        w = self.ws(RuntimeError("down"))
        pid = self.pids(w)[0]
        code, chat_ = serve.route(w, "POST", f"/p/{pid}/chats", {})
        self.assertEqual(code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(serve.route(w, "POST", f"/p/{pid}/chats/{chat_['id']}/send", {"mode": "x", "text": "hi"})[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(serve.route(w, "POST", f"/p/{pid}/chats/99/send", {"mode": "ask", "text": "hello there"})[0], 404)
        self.assertEqual(serve.route(w, "GET", "/p/nothing", {})[0], 404)
        w.system(pid).llm = lambda *a, **k: (_ for _ in ()).throw(RuntimeError("down"))
        w.system(pid).chat = lambda *a, **k: (_ for _ in ()).throw(RuntimeError("tools down"))
        code, body = serve.route(w, "POST", f"/p/{pid}/chats/{chat_['id']}/send", {"mode": "do", "text": "send it", "world": "http://127.0.0.1:9/tools"})

            except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:

content.text:
**Status:** The product workspace is built and passes its tests (161 of 161). I also ran a live smoke of the real UI server with the real model. I did not open it in a real browser, so the visual layout and responsiveness are unverified.

**Design (as you approved)**
- **Isolation:** Each project is its own SQLite file with its own memories, evidence, dependencies, embeddings, forgotten-term hashes and conversations. Isolation is structural, with no project filter in any query, and project ids are generated by the server.
- **Where it runs:** The product API runs in the UI process (`frontend/serve.py`), and `server.py` is untouched.
- **Separation from evaluation:**
  - The product stores everything under its own directory (`$HUSH_PRODUCT_DIR`), never in the evaluation database.
  - The official `/reset` still wipes everything the evaluation service can reach and cannot see or touch any project.
  - The product cannot read evaluation memory. I removed the old `/api` proxy and `/view/memory` routes from the UI server.

**What the UI now does**
- **Projects and chats:** The project switcher can create, rename and delete (with confirmation), and there is a "General" project by default. Conversations persist across restarts, with New chat, rename, delete and clear. Memories are shared across chats in the same project.
- **Receipts:** Tell shows what was really saved, updated (was → now), already known, kept as history, no longer valid, or conflicting, worked out from the stored state before and after. If the model is unavailable it says nothing was saved.
- **Forget:** It shows a verified-removal receipt with counts only. Saved chat messages that carried the erased information are redacted, including the request itself.
- **Memory timeline:** The Memories page has Current, Timeline and All versions views, with badges for derived-from, stale, conflict and private.
- **UI states:** Late replies after a project or chat switch are ignored. The loading, empty, error (with Retry) and confirmation states are in, in the Marginalia style, dark and light.
- **Identity fix (live5):** Memory now derives the user's own handle, and which handles share a first name, from stored events only. The full name "Kavya Menon" appears in no message, so I did not invent it.

**A real bug the live smoke caught, now fixed**
One Tell mentioned both a job offer and a locker number, and forgetting the job offer also erased the locker fact. The rule removed every fact supported only by the erased message. Now a fact from a mixed message goes only if it is about what you asked to forget; otherwise it survives with its own quote, while the raw message text is erased. I re-ran the smoke against the real model and it now keeps the locker fact.

**Tests:** `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes 161 of 161 (22 new). They cover isolation, conversations, receipts, redaction, separation from the evaluation store, and the UI server, plus a syntax check of `app.js`.

**Intentional deviations**
- Plain HTML/JS/CSS instead of React/Vite.
- No QA-import, Pulse or Forget-review pages.
- No preview/confirm for Forget, because your own message is the instruction.
- Do needs the mock world URL typed in.

**Risks**
- **Semantic search:** The UI process needs `pip install fastembed` and a one-time model download. Otherwise it uses keyword search, and the System page shows which is active.
- **Chat history:** Each chat is a log and is not fed to the model as context.

**Next decision:** Open the UI in a browser and try the flows, then run the evaluation. The submission items (`README.md`, `MEMORY.md`, `prompt_history/`) are still missing, and nothing is committed. Details are in `BUILD_STATE.md`.

"""Product experience tests: measured usage, idempotent sends, receipts, Ask details, memory inspection, index status,
schema compatibility, short messages, and prompts free of evaluation examples."""
import os
import shutil
import sqlite3
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from test_stage02 import FakeLLM, chat, fact  # noqa: E402
from test_core import FakeEmbedder  # noqa: E402
from backend.source.api.memory_system import MemorySystem  # noqa: E402
from backend.source.dal.db_session import Database  # noqa: E402
from backend.source.service.projects.workspace import Workspace, WorkspaceError  # noqa: E402
from backend.source.utils import metrics  # noqa: E402

LOCKER = fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my gym locker number is 214")


class Base(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.dir, ignore_errors=True)

    def ws(self, *replies, embedder=None, llm=None):
        self.llm = llm or FakeLLM(*replies)
        w = Workspace(os.path.join(self.dir, "product"), llm_fn=self.llm, embedder=embedder)
        self.pid = w.list_projects()[0]["id"]
        self.cid = w.new_chat(self.pid)["id"]
        return w

    def send(self, w, mode, text, **kw):
        return w.send(self.pid, self.cid, mode, text, **kw)["assistant"]


class UsageTests(Base):
    def test_usage_counts_the_real_model_calls_and_never_adds_one(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [LOCKER]}, {"answer": "214", "know": True, "used": ["F1"]})
        tell = self.send(w, "tell", "Btw my gym locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.")["payload"]["usage"]
        ask = self.send(w, "ask", "What is my gym locker number?")["payload"]["usage"]
        self.assertEqual((tell["model_calls"], ask["model_calls"]), (1, 2))                 # extraction; keywords + answer
        self.assertEqual(len(self.llm.prompts) + len(self.llm.expansions), 3)               # exactly the calls the engine made
        for u in (tell, ask):
            self.assertEqual((u["basis"], u["total_tokens"] == u["input_tokens"] + u["output_tokens"], u["total_tokens"] > 0, u["latency_ms"] >= 0),
                             ("estimated", True, True, True))

    def test_provider_reported_numbers_win_over_estimates_and_a_mix_is_labelled(self):
        def llm(messages, **kw):
            if kw.get("max_tokens") == 900:                      # extraction call: the provider reports its usage
                metrics.current().report({"prompt_tokens": 123, "completion_tokens": 45})
                return '{"facts": []}'
            return '{"answer": "x", "know": false, "used": []}'  # other calls report nothing
        w = self.ws(llm=llm)
        usage = self.send(w, "tell", "Btw my gym locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.")["payload"]["usage"]
        self.assertEqual((usage["basis"], usage["input_tokens"], usage["output_tokens"], usage["total_tokens"]), ("provider", 123, 45, 168))
        self.send(w, "tell", "Another note about something worth keeping for later.")
        meter = metrics.Meter()
        meter.report({"prompt_tokens": 10, "completion_tokens": 2})
        meter.record(99, 99, 0.1)
        meter.record(50, 5, 0.1)
        self.assertEqual((meter.summary()["basis"], meter.summary()["input_tokens"]), ("mixed", 60))

    def test_usage_is_stored_with_the_conversation_turn_and_a_failed_call_is_counted(self):
        w = self.ws(RuntimeError("model down"))
        out = self.send(w, "tell", "Btw my gym locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.")
        self.assertEqual((out["payload"]["usage"]["model_calls"], out["payload"]["usage"]["failed_calls"]), (1, 1))
        stored = w.open_chat(self.pid, self.cid)["messages"][-1]["payload"]["usage"]
        self.assertEqual(stored["model_calls"], 1)

    def test_the_official_path_is_not_metered(self):
        m = MemorySystem(llm_fn=FakeLLM({"facts": []}), db_path=os.path.join(self.dir, "e.db"))
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "Btw my gym locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it."))
        self.assertIsNone(metrics.current())


class IdempotencyAndGuidanceTests(Base):
    def test_the_same_request_id_runs_once_and_returns_the_stored_turn(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [LOCKER]})
        first = w.send(self.pid, self.cid, "tell", "Btw my gym locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.", request_id="req-1")
        again = w.send(self.pid, self.cid, "tell", "Btw my gym locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.", request_id="req-1")
        self.assertTrue(again["replayed"])
        self.assertEqual((again["assistant"]["id"], len(self.llm.prompts), len(w.open_chat(self.pid, self.cid)["messages"])), (first["assistant"]["id"], 1, 2))
        self.assertEqual(len(w.memory(self.pid)["facts"]), 1)

    def test_a_question_typed_into_tell_is_guided_to_ask_without_storing_or_calling_the_model(self):
        w = self.ws()
        out = self.send(w, "tell", "What is my gym locker number?")
        self.assertEqual((out["payload"]["guidance"], len(self.llm.prompts), out["payload"]["usage"]["model_calls"]), ("ask", 0, 0))
        self.assertIn("use Ask", out["content"])
        self.assertEqual(w.memory(self.pid)["facts"], [])

    def test_a_statement_with_a_question_mark_inside_is_still_remembered(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [LOCKER]})
        out = self.send(w, "tell", "Remember? my gym locker number is 214 and that is that.")
        self.assertEqual((out["payload"].get("guidance"), len(out["payload"]["saved"])), (None, 1))

    def test_short_meaningful_messages_are_extracted_and_empty_acknowledgements_are_not(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [fact("user", "diet", "vegan", "I'm vegan", "STATE")]})
        saved = self.send(w, "tell", "I'm vegan.")["payload"]
        self.assertEqual((len(saved["saved"]), len(self.llm.prompts)), (1, 1))
        for ack in ["ok thanks", "Thanks!", "hi", "ok"]:
            self.send(w, "tell", ack)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.llm.prompts), 1)                                          # no model call for them


class ReceiptTests(Base):
    def test_an_update_appears_only_under_updated_with_the_real_before_and_after(self):
        old1 = fact("user", "preferred editor", "Emacs", "my preferred editor is Emacs", "PREFERENCE")
        old2 = fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my gym locker number is 214")
        new1 = dict(fact("user", "preferred editor", "VS Code", "my preferred editor is now VS Code", "PREFERENCE"), replaces=1)
        new2 = dict(fact("user", "gym locker number", "315", "my gym locker number is now 315"), replaces=2)

import sys
import tempfile

LOCKER = fact("user", "gym locker number", "214", "my gym locker number is 214")

        self.dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.dir, ignore_errors=True)

    def ws(self, *replies, embedder=None, llm=None):
        self.llm = llm or FakeLLM(*replies)
        w = Workspace(os.path.join(self.dir, "product"), llm_fn=self.llm, embedder=embedder)
        self.pid = w.list_projects()[0]["id"]
        self.cid = w.new_chat(self.pid)["id"]
        return w

    def send(self, w, mode, text, **kw):
        return w.send(self.pid, self.cid, mode, text, **kw)["assistant"]

    def test_usage_counts_the_real_model_calls_and_never_adds_one(self):
        w = self.ws({"facts": [LOCKER]}, {"answer": "214", "know": True, "used": ["F1"]})
        tell = self.send(w, "tell", "Btw my gym locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.")["payload"]["usage"]
        ask = self.send(w, "ask", "What is my gym locker number?")["payload"]["usage"]
        self.assertEqual((tell["model_calls"], ask["model_calls"]), (1, 2))                 # extraction; keywords + answer
        self.assertEqual(len(self.llm.prompts) + len(self.llm.expansions), 3)               # exactly the calls the engine made
        for u in (tell, ask):
            self.assertEqual((u["basis"], u["total_tokens"] == u["input_tokens"] + u["output_tokens"], u["total_tokens"] > 0, u["latency_ms"] >= 0),
                             ("estimated", True, True, True))

    def test_provider_reported_numbers_win_over_estimates_and_a_mix_is_labelled(self):
        def llm(messages, **kw):
            if kw.get("max_tokens") == 900:                      # extraction call: the provider reports its usage
                metrics.current().report({"prompt_tokens": 123, "completion_tokens": 45})
                return '{"facts": []}'
            return '{"answer": "x", "know": false, "used": []}'  # other calls report nothing
        w = self.ws(llm=llm)
        usage = self.send(w, "tell", "Btw my gym locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it.")["payload"]["usage"]
        self.assertEqual((usage["basis"], usage["input_tokens"], usage["output_tokens"], usage["total_tokens"]), ("provider", 123, 45, 168))
        self.send(w, "tell", "Another note about something worth keeping for later.")
        meter = metrics.Meter()
        meter.report({"prompt_tokens": 10, "completion_tokens": 2})
        meter.record(99, 99, 0.1)
        meter.record(50, 5, 0.1)
        self.assertEqual((meter.summary()["basis"], meter.summary()["input_tokens"]), ("mixed", 60))

        w = self.ws(RuntimeError("model down"))

        self.assertEqual((out["payload"]["usage"]["model_calls"], out["payload"]["usage"]["failed_calls"]), (1, 1))
        stored = w.open_chat(self.pid, self.cid)["messages"][-1]["payload"]["usage"]
        self.assertEqual(stored["model_calls"], 1)

        m = MemorySystem(llm_fn=FakeLLM({"facts": []}), db_path=os.path.join(self.dir, "e.db"))
        m.add_message(chat("m1", "Btw my gym locker number is 214, I keep forgetting it."))

Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork runs in the background and keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate. Subagents run in the background; you'll be notified when one completes. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
